lessons.claim: Updating time-dependent driving from an updater every U steps makes the driving **zero-order hold (ZOH)**, so the fundamental is reduced by sinc(ωΔt/2) and its phase lags by ωΔt/2 (Δt=U·dt). Measured |ŷ_c|/a = 0.98999 against the ZOH prediction 0.99040, and a phase of −0.2522 against −0.2404 rad. **The nominal amplitude must not be used** in the response-function estimator -- measuring the ghost (anchor) position too and using the measured phasor cancels the ZOH attenuation between numerator and denominator. The K′ using the nominal is −6559 at De=10 (the sign is wrong too, a 236% error), while using the measured phasor gives 5863 (21%). It is quietly wrong, with no error.
